note: What a server sends to lay out both sides and who is on them, while the match is being put together.

fields.name: sideRoom
fields.note: How many seats the first side has room for.

fields.name: otherSideRoom
fields.note: How many the other has room for.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The seats on one side, twenty four places. The count below says how many of the leading places carry a seat; the rest hold zero. A place cannot be read on its own, because zero is a seat a match gives out as well as what an unused place holds.

fields.name: otherSide
fields.note: The seats on the other, under the same reading and its own count.

fields.name: sideTaken
fields.note: How many of the leading places on the first side carry a seat.
